items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Well the old man Ullett, I played with him, with, uh, in Bucktown.

ctx.x: But I ain't talking about him. I'm talking about old Ullett. Ullett? Ullett. Ullett, not Morett.
No, you know what he talked about. Old man Ullett used to play, uh, Violet. Oh, Violet.
